description: Propose rolling a policy back to one of its revisions (list_policy_revisions): its whole configuration - apps, settings, restrictions, networks - is restored, and its name goes back to the revision's when they differ (the change list shows it); description, tags and group stay. Nothing changes yet: this returns a proposal with the differences. Show it to the user and get their explicit approval. A rollback of a policy that has devices is HIGH impact. With onlyThisRevision: undo only what that revision changed (explain_changes names it), keeping later saves; prefer it when one change caused a problem. To undo the latest save, restore the revision before it instead (no onlyThisRevision). Once the user approves, apply it with apply_policy_proposal (a person approves a HIGH impact one in the Nomid portal instead: give the user its approvalUrl).

company.description: Optional: a `company` value from list_companies to run this in. Omit it for the connection's own company.

onlyThisRevision.description: true: undo only what this revision changed and keep everything saved after it (a field changed again since stays and is listed). Default false: restore the whole policy to this revision.

policyId.description: The policy's path name - the unique identifier returned by list_policies as "pathName".

revision.description: The revision to restore, from list_policy_revisions; with onlyThisRevision, the revision whose changes to undo.

name: rollback_policy
title: Propose a policy rollback
